body:
This is indeed something that I don't see as possible with our current widgets, and has come up before (a while ago) in the context of dates. In this case this seems very similar (exactly the same) as a numeric menu, but with multiple attributes. I'd suggest you also start that way:

1. fork https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/src/connectors/numeric-menu/connectNumericMenu.js
2. read from the item instead of the attribute given in the argument

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/src/connectors/numeric-menu/connectNumericMenu.js#L273

3. add the key `attribute` to each of the options
